derivation.method: Select the catalog’s 127 Standard Basic leaf IDs with their full original source extents and exact ancestry IDs. Apply coordinate precision only. Product territory clipping occurs in the region loader, not in this reusable dataset. No Broad polygons, EPA residuals or historical mountain-footprint enlargement.
derivation.repair: none; all selected full source and quantized geometries valid
derivation.precisionMethod: GEOS set_precision valid_output; normalize; counterclockwise exterior rings and clockwise holes

limitations: Standard is a regional mountain inventory and can omit low foothills and worthwhile low-relief hiking landscapes. This does not assert trail-scale survey accuracy, source completeness, current access or route quality.

Each retained leaf preserves its full source extent, including territory outside currently offered regions. The catalog selects a subset of the global inventory; new selections may require additional leaves. Coordinate precision is not a positional-accuracy claim.
